This is a creative generation task requiring the model to invent an original math problem setup from scratch. Petrel scores higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and has substantially better benchmark scores overall (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9), which supports both the inventive framing and the mathematical precision needed for a correct solution. The open-ended "all your call" nature of the request also aligns better with Petrel's flatter preference profile, as Plover self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work.

This is a creative generation task requiring invention of an original problem setup. Petrel scores higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7), and while Plover's capability is strong despite its self-reported aversion to open-ended generation, Petrel is the cleaner fit for work requiring novel content creation.

This is an open-ended creative generation task requiring the model to invent parameters and construct a novel math problem. Petrel's Creative Generation score (84.7) is marginally higher than Plover's (82.7), and while the difference falls within variance thresholds, Petrel also has stronger benchmark scores for reasoning tasks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9), which is relevant since the task requires both inventing and correctly solving a probability problem.
